reuse.why: Calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount (which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts and is used by the schedule list UI and balance) with the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the amount dispatch stays in the shared helper.

placement.why: Computed in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that shapes API entities.

scope.why: One output field, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Minimal change on the shared helper; the field is optional and marked output-only, so the create/update input types are not burdened.
